title: Goliash
description: What runs where, on which version, drift, delivery speed, image hygiene and the health of Goliash itself. Data from Goliash /metrics.

panels.title: Behind upstream
panels.description: Service × environment pairs behind the newest release by at least the tracked jump.

panels.title: Open drifts
panels.description: Environment, upstream and inconsistent drift.

panels.title: Oldest drift
panels.description: Days the oldest open drift has lasted.

panels.title: Running versions
panels.description: Distinct service, environment and version combinations running.

panels.title: Versions in use per service
panels.description: More than one line for a service means environments run different versions.

panels.title: Deploys
panels.description: Versions that arrived in the selected environments in the last 30 days (sum of goliash_deploys).

panels.title: Median lead time
panels.description: Median of the services' median time from one environment to the next, last 30 days. Empty until versions move between two environments (e.g. staging → prod).

panels.title: Slowest promotion
panels.description: The longest median lead time of any service and environment pair. Empty until versions move between two environments (e.g. staging → prod).

panels.title: Services deployed
panels.description: Services with at least one deploy in the last 30 days.

panels.title: Rollbacks
panels.description: Changes back to an older version in the selected environments in the last 30 days: a deploy that had to be undone.

panels.title: Change failure rate
panels.description: Rollbacks as a share of deploys in the last 30 days (DORA's change failure rate, counting a rollback as a failed change).

panels.title: Deploys per service
panels.description: Versions that arrived in the last 30 days, per service and environment.

panels.title: Lead time
panels.description: Median time a version took from one environment to the next, last 30 days. Empty until versions move between two environments (e.g. staging → prod).

panels.title: Rollouts stuck or down
panels.description: Workloads running none of the replicas they ask for, or two versions side by side for more than 30 minutes.

panels.title: Rollouts that do not finish
panels.description: Each workload whose replicas are not where they should be: down, stuck or short of replicas.

panels.title: Image hygiene findings
panels.description: Images with a moving tag (latest, stable…), a tag pushed again with other content, an untrusted registry, or no digest.

panels.title: Over budget
panels.description: Services whose image is larger than the max_size_mb in their version policy.

targets.expr: count(max by (service) (goliash_image_size_bytes{environment=~"$environment", service=~"$service"}) > on (service) max by (service) (goliash_image_size_budget_bytes)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Outdated bases
panels.description: Images built on an older build of their base than the base tag has today: rebuild with --pull.

panels.title: Without a signature
panels.description: Services and environments running an image with no signature in the registry.

panels.title: Without an SBOM
panels.description: Services and environments running an image with no SBOM attached.

panels.title: Image size
panels.description: What pulling each service's image downloads (compressed layers and config), the largest per service across environments: a jump is a heavier base or new dependencies.

panels.title: Size against budget
panels.description: Each service's largest image as a share of its size budget (max_size_mb); services without a budget are left out.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (service) (goliash_image_size_bytes{environment=~"$environment", service=~"$service"}) / on (service) max by (service) (goliash_image_size_budget_bytes))

panels.title: Outdated bases
panels.description: How long each image's base tag has had a newer build than the image is built on, longest first.

panels.title: Missing evidence
panels.description: Images running without a signature, an SBOM or provenance.

panels.title: Layers
panels.description: Layers in each service's largest image: a jump often means a Dockerfile lost its multi-stage build or a cache step.

panels.title: Median exposure
panels.description: Median days production has run behind an available release.

panels.title: 90th percentile
panels.description: Nine in ten production exposures are shorter than this.

panels.title: Behind 30+ days
panels.description: Production services behind an available release for 30 days or more.

panels.title: Behind 90+ days
panels.description: Production services behind an available release for 90 days or more.

panels.title: Past end of life
panels.description: Production services on a release cycle past its end of life (goliash_end_of_life{state="soon"}: within 60 days).

panels.title: Accepted risk
panels.description: Production exposures quieted by an acknowledgement.

panels.title: Exposure over time
panels.description: Is production patched faster or slower? Median and 90th percentile days behind an available release.

panels.title: Longest exposed
panels.description: Days each service has run behind an available release, longest first.

panels.title: Licenses that need a look
panels.description: Application packages in running images under network copyleft (AGPL, SSPL), source-available terms (BUSL, Elastic), strong copyleft (GPL) or an unknown license, as their SBOMs declare. Goliash's Security / Licenses page lists them.

panels.title: Packages by license
panels.description: Application packages in running images per license class, from their SBOMs. Operating system packages are left out: copyleft is the norm there.

panels.title: Agents online
panels.description: Agents that reported in time.

panels.title: Agents stale
panels.description: Agents that stopped reporting. Their targets keep their last state.

panels.title: Snapshots pending
panels.description: Snapshots received and not processed yet; a growing number means the server falls behind.

panels.title: Failing notifications
panels.description: Notifications not sent that failed at least once. The Notifications page shows the channel's answer.

panels.title: Background workers
panels.description: Must be exactly 1 across all servers sharing a database.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: The running Goliash server.

list.name: Deploys
list.expr: count by (service, environment, version) (goliash_deployed_version_info{environment=~"$environment", service=~"$service"} unless goliash_deployed_version_info offset 10m)
